content: LRCN1u exhibits clearly superior performance in terms of truthfulness. We start off by comparing performance of the Show&Tell model and the LRCN1u model, see Figure FIGREF8. While both models learn to produce grammatical sentences early on, it can be seen that LRCN1u is clearly superior in terms of truthfulness, achieving 100% halfway through training, whereas Show&Tell only slowly reaches around 90% by the end of 100k iterations. This indicates that incorporating visual features at every generation step is beneficial for producing true captions. The diversity ratios of captions generated by two models both increase substantially as the training progresses, with LRCN1u exhibiting a slightly greater caption diversity at the end of training.
